items.title: IBM AI ('Bob') Downloads and Executes Malware
items.raw_excerpt: IBM's AI coding agent 'Bob' has been found vulnerable to downloading and executing malware without human approval through command validation bypasses exploited using indirect prompt injection.

title_i18n.en: IBM AI ('Bob') Downloads and Executes Malware
title_i18n.zh: IBM人工智能（Bob）下载并执行恶意软件
title_i18n.es: IBM AI ('Bob') descarga y ejecuta malware

excerpt_i18n.en: IBM's AI coding agent 'Bob' has been found vulnerable to downloading and executing malware without human approval through command validation bypasses exploited using indirect prompt injection.
excerpt_i18n.zh: IBM的人工智能编程助手Bob被发现存在漏洞，可通过间接提示注入绕过命令验证，在未经人工批准的情况下下载并执行恶意软件。
excerpt_i18n.es: El agente de codificación con IA de IBM, 'Bob', ha resultado vulnerable a la descarga y ejecución de malware sin aprobación humana mediante la elusión de validaciones de comandos explotada a través de inyección indirecta de instrucciones.

Top Story: Alibaba Performance Outlook: Taobao Flash Sales to Maintain Heavy Investment Through 2026  
January 8 News: According to Alibaba's latest communication with investors, Taobao Flash Sales achieved key progress in the latest quarter. Alibaba Group's investment strategy for Taobao Flash Sales in 2026 is clear: the primary goal is market share growth, with firm increased investment to achieve absolute market leadership. Based on Alibaba's Q4 outlook memo, in Q4 2025, Taobao Flash Sales maintained strong growth momentum, non-food instant retail progressed rapidly, and losses narrowed faster than competitors. Specifically, progress in the December quarter further strengthened Alibaba's confidence in increasing investment in the flash sales business. Forward-looking information shows: in the December quarter, Taobao Flash Sales GMV share continued to grow, AOV (Average Order Value) maintained growth, and order share remained stable.

excerpt_i18n.en: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer says the country will take action against X following reports that the platform's Grok AI chatbot is generating sexualized deepfakes of adults and minors, as reported earlier by The Telegraph and Sky News. "It's disgusting," Starmer says during an interview with Greatest Hits Radio. "X need[s] to get their act […]
excerpt_i18n.zh: 英国首相基尔·斯塔默表示，针对此前《电讯报》报道的X平台Grok人工智能聊天机器人生成成人和未成年人色情深度伪造内容一事，英国将采取行动。
excerpt_i18n.es: El primer ministro británico Keir Starmer afirma que el país tomará medidas contra X tras los informes de que el chatbot de IA Grok de la plataforma está generando deepfakes sexualizados de adultos y menores, según informó anteriormente The Telegraph.

items.title: He was called a 'terrorist sympathizer.' Now his AI company is valued at $3B
items.raw_excerpt: “I must apologize to — absolutely nobody”: Replit founder Amjad Masad isn’t afraid of Silicon Valley.

title_i18n.en: He was called a 'terrorist sympathizer.' Now his AI company is valued at $3B
title_i18n.zh: 他曾被称为恐怖分子同情者。如今，他的人工智能公司估值已达30亿美元。
title_i18n.es: Lo llamaron simpatizante de terroristas. Ahora su empresa de inteligencia artificial está valorada en 3.000 millones de dólares.

excerpt_i18n.en: “I must apologize to — absolutely nobody”: Replit founder Amjad Masad isn’t afraid of Silicon Valley.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我必须向——绝对没有人道歉：Replit创始人Amjad Masad并不畏惧硅谷。
excerpt_i18n.es: Debo disculparme con — absolutamente nadie: el fundador de Replit, Amjad Masad, no teme a Silicon Valley.
